tagline: Give every agent a contract. From intent to a verified candidate.
title: Concorde Framework

homepage.title: Give every agent a contract.
homepage.description: Turn a change request into a reviewed, validated candidate. Concorde gives each agent a complete Module contract, explicit file access and evidence you can inspect.

features.title: Know what changed. Know why it’s ready.

items.title: Complete contracts. Bounded context.
items.description: Each task receives its Module’s entire Spec collection. Planners reason from its promises; code writers receive the declared implementation files. Dependencies never silently expand context.

items.title: Boundaries the host enforces.
items.description: Agents receive explicit context and file permissions. Configured checks run with OS-enforced read-only project access and external scratch space. Unsupported enforcement blocks execution.

items.title: Shared code. Every consumer counted.
items.description: A reverse index tracks every Module that lists a file. Change shared code, and each affected contract needs its own checks and evidence in a separate Module context.

items.title: Evidence that stays honest.
items.description: Reviews and validation identify the inputs they assessed. Relevant changes invalidate old evidence. Missing promises become named Spec gaps, with progress preserved for the next invocation.

items.title: A worktree for every change.
items.description: The development loop stops at a ready candidate. Delivery verifies integration and stages an independent branch. Merging into primary requires a separate, explicit request.

items.title: Explore the system behind the patch.
items.description: Read contracts alongside their entity diagrams and browse composition and dependency graphs. Optional LangGraph Studio exposes the execution graphs and live events behind the workflow.

workflow.title: From intent to a ready candidate.
workflow.description: One change, an inspectable path. The default loop authors the Spec and runs reviews; missing contracts and failed checks preserve progress instead of claiming completion.

steps.title: Route & specify
steps.description: Select the responsible Module, establish its contract and review the Spec.

steps.title: Plan & implement
steps.description: Turn the contract into tasks, then write code with the declared file access.

steps.title: Validate & review
steps.description: Run configured checks and code review. Bind the resulting evidence to the actual inputs.

steps.title: Ready to deliver
steps.description: Inspect the candidate. Request delivery when ready; request the primary merge separately.

quickstart.title: Bring a contract to your next change.
quickstart.description: Clone and build Concorde, then preview installation into your Git project. Use Python 3.11+, Node.js 18+ and npm; configured checks require Linux with bubblewrap, working namespaces and pidfd support. Choose Codex or Claude and initialize through the installed Skills.
quickstart.code:
git clone https://github.com/FTOD/concorde.git
cd concorde
python3 scripts/concorde.py build

# Replace the path with your Git project.
python3 scripts/install-concorde.py \
  --target /absolute/path/to/project \
  --integration codex --preview

# Review the preview, then rerun with --apply.
